items.title: Full Stack Laravel Developer
bullets: Built a multi-tenant clinic management platform from scratch (Laravel 12, database-per-tenant): scheduling with conflict and capacity checks using transactions and row locks, public booking with capacity holds, patient portal, prescriptions, invoices, reports, Arabic/English. Live: https://clinics.huntech.net

Built the ZMK e-learning ecosystem: 3 integrated systems, about 75 features. Student website and admin dashboard from scratch, plus an E-Learning module and two-way integration in the client's ERP. VdoCipher playback with student watermark, quizzes, progress tracking, rewards, email OTP, Paymob checkout. Live: https://zmk-eg.com

Turned the core ERP modules into a SaaS subscription product for small shops: database-per-tenant, trials and grace periods, renewals that keep remaining time, module licensing via middleware, per-user licensing. Live: https://subscription.hunt-eg.com

Built the Paymob payment integration for the company website: Unified Checkout, HMAC-SHA512 verification on both redirect and webhook, activation of subscriptions, modules and extra users through REST APIs.
Enhancements and bug fixes across ERP modules (Accounting, HR, Inventory, CRM, POS).
